prompt:

Asset: replacement transparent player avatar for Nastya Feshchenko in the established cozy Ukrainian board-game painted cat portrait series.
Input images: Image 1, the NEW photograph in front of the brick wall, is the SOLE identity, face, smile, hair and clothing reference. Image 2 supplies ONLY the approved gouache/colored-pencil medium, real feline anatomy and contained upper-bust framing. Do not copy image 2's face, neutral expression, long hair or blue sweater. Do not use any older Nastya photo or avatar as an identity reference.

Preserve her soft oval face with naturally full cheeks, softly arched medium-brown eyebrows, light gray-green eyes with their original spacing, warm broad open smile showing the upper teeth, lifted cheeks and slight smiling squint. Match the friendly cheerful expression rather than a neutral face. Preserve her natural adult proportions and relaxed appearance, no exaggerated doll eyes, no beauty makeup.
Hair: natural medium/light chestnut-brown hair with warm dark-blond highlights, just touching the shoulders, parted near the center, smooth and slightly tousled with subtly curved ends, as in this new photograph. NOT very long hair, bangs or a short chin bob.
Feline anatomy: a real short elegant cat muzzle, small natural feline nose and fine delicate whiskers, muted warm sandy/taupe fur with cream muzzle and cheek highlights. EXACTLY TWO pointed CAT ears TOTAL on TOP of the head, both fully inside frame with ample clear margin above them. At the sides of the head, uninterrupted hair and fur only: NO human ears, side ears, fleshy lobes or additional ears. Omit jewelry if it would introduce a side human ear.

Style: detailed warm hand-painted gouache and colored pencil, softly dimensional textured fur, hair and cotton fabric, warm brown contours and ivory highlights, matching the established portrait series.
Composition: square canvas, single centered nearly frontal head-and-upper-torso bust, eyes toward viewer and source's cheerful smiling expression, naturally rounded lower shoulder silhouette, generous transparent margins around all head, hair and ears. No hands or lower body.
Backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha. Remove the brick wall and all scenery, objects and shadows outside the character. No other people, props, background circle, badge, frame, text or watermark.
